notes.title: Update Notice #7
notes.content:
Hello.
Thank you for using Fujisan Nobori.

Guiding you through the update #7.

[b]【Added】[/b]

- Added virtual PVP content(Recommended Level: LV.33 or higher)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963743/fa818cc44adf1c21c43987f7ca4c6693e954c7cb.png[/img]

Fight against virtual user characters on the 2nd floor of the 'Training Center' and win to collect 'Medals of Victory'. 
Currently, there are characters at levels 33, 66, and 99.
These can be exchanged for item packages from the NPC on the 1st floor of the 'Training Center'. 
The more 'Medals of Victory' you collect, the better the item packages you will receive.

- New map added

Maze 4(Formerly: Secluded Path)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963743/2e6b43e9496e64b03779110da67de1e81e713b59.png[/img]

Medal of Victory, Potion, Mana Potion, Intermediate Potion, Intermediate Mana Potion, Advanced Potion, Advanced Mana Potion

- New armor added

Emblem of Victory(left), Emblem of Victory(right)

[b]【Fixed】[/b]

- Modify to center align the allied battle screen.

- Fixed the issue where prison uniforms were not being provided in the prison.

- Some translations corrected.

- Other bugs fixed.

I will try even harder.
Thank you.
